illustration.method: Three original 9:16 hand-inked skyline plates use the licensed photographs only as geometry references and the approved desktop illustration as the style reference; source photographs do not appear in the website media.
illustration.creditAccounting: 8.25 credits for three plates plus 31.5 credits for three silent six-second structural morphs; the recovered New York-to-Chicago pilot is counted once.

render.tools: Local FFmpeg 8.0.1 and cwebp; two FFmpeg threads, no new dependency
render.composition: Each state is normalized to a 720x1280 content field with 320 pixels of mirrored quiet-paper texture above it. The closed loop holds each city for four seconds and structurally morphs for six seconds in New York, Chicago, San Francisco order.
